'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes (2024–present)|Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes]]
**[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
***[[Pakistan]] carries out a series of [[airstrikes]] in [[Barmal District]] and [[Urgun District]], [[Paktia Province]], [[Afghanistan]], killing ten people and wounding eight others, ending the 48–hour [[ceasefire]] which started two days ago. [https://kabulnow.com/2025/10/pakistan-airstrikes-kill-10-in-eastern-afghanistan-taliban-says-ceasefire-broken/?tztc=1 (Kabul Now)]
***The [[International Federation of Journalists]] confirm that a media worker was among those killed during the Pakistani airstrikes in [[Kabul]], Afghanistan, two days ago. Journalist Abdul Ghafoor Abed was also shot dead while covering the [[shootout]]s at the [[Durand Line|border]]. [https://www.ifj.org/media-centre/news/detail/category/press-releases/article/afghanistan-second-journalist-killed-in-afghanistan-in-two-days (IFJ)]
***The casualty toll from the Pakistani airstrikes in [[Spin Boldak]], Afghanistan, two days ago, increases to 40 people killed and 170 injured. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-196176 (Tolo News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza peace plan]]
***[[Hamas]] returns one more [[Gaza hostage crisis|hostage's body]] to the [[Red Cross]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20251017-turkey-recover-hostages-gaza-trump-hamas (France 24)]
***Israelis fire at a vehicle carrying a displaced family in [[Gaza City]], killing eleven [[Palestinians]], including seven children. The [[IDF]] claims it crossed the ceasefire demarcation line. [https://efe.com/en/latest-news/2025-10-18/11-dead-including-children-in-israeli-strike-on-gaza-family-minibus/ (EFE)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/18/world/middleeast/israel-military-gaza-strike-cease-fire.html (New York Times)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpv1nk7dy4yo (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**At least 14 people are killed, including six attackers, and 13 others are injured in a [[Suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]] followed by gunfire at a military compound in [[Mir Ali, Pakistan|Mir Ali]], [[North Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], Pakistan. [[Harkat-ul-Jihad al-Islami]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20251017/0260a5562cf343a29b4ff1e296c682d7/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Rahova gas explosion]]
**Three people are killed and 14 others are injured in an explosion caused by a suspected [[gas leak]] at an apartment building in [[Bucharest]], [[Romania]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/two-killed-bucharest-after-explosion-apartment-block-2025-10-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Typhoon Halong (2025)]]
**[[Alaska]] [[Governor of Alaska|governor]] [[Mike Dunleavy (politician)|Mike Dunleavy]] requests [[FEMA|federal disaster assistance]], as flooding in remote villages forces over 2,000 to potentially face a prolonged evacuation longer than 18 months, caused by the remnants of Halong. [https://apnews.com/article/alaska-typhoon-flooding-7e6e6b72c5587c3a00b82982ffab56bd (AP)]
*At least 17 people are killed and others are injured when a bus loses control, hits rocks and overturns on a [[highway]] in [[Pernambuco]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/passenger-bus-crash-in-northeastern-brazil-leaves-17-dead/ (CTV News)] [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/15-killed-after-bus-loses-control-hits-rock-and-overturns-in-brazil-2805274-2025-10-18?utm_source=recengine&utm_medium=web&referral=yes&utm_content=footerstrip-4&t_source=recengine&t_medium=web&t_content=footerstrip-4&t_psl=True (''The Times of India'')]
*Three people are killed and eight others injured during an explosion at an [[munitions factory|explosives plant]] in [[Sterlitamak]], [[Bashkortostan]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/blast-explosives-plant-russias-bashkortostan-kills-three-people-governor-says-2025-10-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping]]
**The [[Ministry of National Defense (China)|Ministry of National Defense of China]] announces that [[Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission|Vice Chairman]] of the [[Central Military Commission of China]] [[He Weidong]], Director of the [[Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission]] [[Miao Hua]] and seven other generals were expelled from the [[Chinese Communist Party|party]] and the [[People's Liberation Army|military]] following charges of [[Corruption in China|corruption]] against them. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3329429/chinas-no-2-general-he-weidong-expelled-communist-party (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Hijab and burka controversies in Europe]]
**The [[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|parliament]] approves a ban on [[Veil|face veils]] for "gender or religious" reasons and making it punishable by up to [[Euro|{{Euro}}]]2,000. The bill, promoted by [[right-wing]] party [[Chega]], is passed to [[President of Portugal|President]] [[Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa]] for review. [https://apnews.com/article/muslim-face-covering-veils-europe-right-0a1828738d595a71b7bb662e608e1766 (AP)]
*[[Killing of Salwan Momika]]
**A 24-year-old man from [[Syria]], living in Sweden at the time, is identified as the main perpetrator who assassinated [[Criticism of Islam|anti-Islam]] activist [[Salwan Momika]]. [https://www.jpost.com/international/article-870620 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Nord Stream pipelines sabotage]]
**The [[Poland|Polish]] [[Judiciary of Poland|judiciary]] refuses [[extradition]] of a [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]]  to [[Germany]] who is suspected of blowing up the [[Nord Stream]] pipeline, citing lack of evidence, arguing that it happened in [[international waters]], on [[Russia]]n-owned property, and amidst the [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian aggression against his state]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/nord-stream-poland-blocks-extradition-of-suspect-to-germany/a-74395861 (DW)]
*[[WikiConference North America]]
**A man brandishes a firearm and threatens to kill himself on stage at the 2025 "Wiki World’s Fair" event in [[New York City]]. A Wikipedia contributor disarms the man, who was later taken into custody. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/17/nyregion/wikipedia-conference-gunman.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.newsweek.com/nyc-wikipedia-conference-gun-threat-arrest-10897284 (''Newsweek'')]
